# What the updater reads from latest.json. Each `in` line is a whole file, the
# `out` line after it what is taken from it ("none": no release is offered).
# Read by the app's tests (src/update.rs) and by tools/sign_release's, so the
# release tool's `verify` and the app can't drift apart.

in {"version": "0.2.0", "asset": "OrangeLink-v0.2.0-windows-x64.zip", "sha256": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", "sig": "c2ln", "notes": ""}
out tag=v0.2.0 | asset=OrangeLink-v0.2.0-windows-x64.zip | sha256=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa | sig=c2ln

in {"version": "v1.2.3"}
out tag=v1.2.3 | asset=- | sha256=- | sig=-

in   {"version": " 0.2.0 ", "asset": " OrangeLink.zip ", "sha256": " ABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABAB ", "sig": "  x  "}
out tag=v0.2.0 | asset=OrangeLink.zip | sha256=ABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABABAB | sig=x

in {"version": "vvv1.2.3"}
out tag=v1.2.3 | asset=- | sha256=- | sig=-

in {"version": "1.2.+3"}
out tag=v1.2.+3 | asset=- | sha256=- | sig=-

in {"version": "01.002.3"}
out tag=v01.002.3 | asset=- | sha256=- | sig=-

in {"version": "v 1.2.3"}
out tag=v 1.2.3 | asset=- | sha256=- | sig=-

in {"version": "4294967295.0.0"}
out tag=v4294967295.0.0 | asset=- | sha256=- | sig=-

in {"version": "4294967296.0.0"}
out none

in {"version": "１.2.3"}
out none

in {"version": "-1.2.3"}
out none

in {"version": "soon"}
out none

in {"version": "1.2"}
out none

in {"version": "1.2.3.4"}
out none

in {"version": 3}
out none

in {"Version": "0.2.0"}
out none

in {"version": "0.1.0", "version": "9.9.9"}
out tag=v9.9.9 | asset=- | sha256=- | sig=-

in [1, 2]
out none

in "0.2.0"
out none

in
out none

in <!DOCTYPE html><html>
out none

in Not Found
out none

in {"version": "0.2.0",}
out none

in {"version": "0.2.0"} x
out none

in {"version": "0.2.0"}{"version": "0.3.0"}
out none

in {"version": "0.2.0", "n": 01}
out none

in {"version": "0.2.0", "n": 1.}
out none

in {"version": "0.2.0", "notes": "\ud800"}
out none

in {"version": "0.2.0", "notes": "\x41"}
out none

in {"version": "0.2.0", "notes": 'single'}
out none

in {"version": "0.2.0", "extra": {"nested": [1, -2.5e3, 0, 1E+2, true, false, null, "q\"\\\/\b\f\n\r\té😀"]}, "list": []}
out tag=v0.2.0 | asset=- | sha256=- | sig=-

in {"version": "0.2.0", "asset": "OrangeLink.zip"}
out tag=v0.2.0 | asset=OrangeLink.zip | sha256=- | sig=-

in {"version": "0.2.0", "asset": "../x.zip", "sha256": "xyz", "sig": ""}
out tag=v0.2.0 | asset=- | sha256=- | sig=-

in {"version": "0.2.0", "asset": "x.exe", "sha256": 5, "sig": null}
out tag=v0.2.0 | asset=- | sha256=- | sig=-

in {"version": "0.2.0", "sha256": "gggggggggggggggggggggggggggggggggggggggggggggggggggggggggggggggg"}
out tag=v0.2.0 | asset=- | sha256=- | sig=-

in {"version": "0.2.0", "sig": "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA"}
out tag=v0.2.0 | asset=- | sha256=- | sig=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA

in {"version": "0.2.0", "sig": "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA"}
out tag=v0.2.0 | asset=- | sha256=- | sig=-

in {"version": "0.2.0", "url": "https://example.com/x.zip", "host": "example.com"}
out tag=v0.2.0 | asset=- | sha256=- | sig=-

# Numbers: serde_json refuses one that is infinite as an f64.

in {"version": "0.2.0", "n": 1e400}
out none

in {"version": "0.2.0", "n": -1e400}
out none

in {"version": "0.2.0", "n": -2.5e3800}
out none

in {"version": "0.2.0", "n": 1E+309}
out none

in {"version": "0.2.0", "n": }
out none

in {"version": "0.2.0", "n": 1e308}
out tag=v0.2.0 | asset=- | sha256=- | sig=-

in {"version": "0.2.0", "n": 1e-400}
out tag=v0.2.0 | asset=- | sha256=- | sig=-

in {"version": "0.2.0", "n": 0e99999}
out tag=v0.2.0 | asset=- | sha256=- | sig=-

in {"version": "0.2.0", "n": 18446744073709551616}
out tag=v0.2.0 | asset=- | sha256=- | sig=-

in {"version": "0.2.0", "n": -0}
out tag=v0.2.0 | asset=- | sha256=- | sig=-

in {"version": "0.2.0", "n": 123456789012345678901234567890}
out tag=v0.2.0 | asset=- | sha256=- | sig=-

# Nesting: 127 levels in all (the object and 126 arrays) is the most serde_json reads.
